entries.zh: 一切伟大之作都需要牺牲来铸就。星系中的其他生物或许不能理解，但他们必将服从。
entries.en: All great works require sacrifice. The rest of the galaxy may not understand, but they will comply.

entries.zh: 秩序是反自然的。真正的自然应当处于混沌之中。\n\n我们不是在毁灭宇宙，而是在修复它。
entries.en: Order is unnatural. The true nature of matter is in a chaotic state.\n\nWe are not destroying the universe - we are repairing it.

entries.zh: 统治的权利只属于胜利者。对于这句话，我们将其奉为至上真理，同时欢迎其他任何人来尝试证明其实我们错了。
entries.en: The right to rule belongs to whomever is victorious. We are claiming that right, and anyone is free to try and prove us wrong.

entries.zh: 如果所有人的目光都被舞台中央那位蹦蹦跳跳的小丑所吸引，那么你就能在阴影中进行更多的行动了。
entries.en: If everyone is looking at the dancing fools in the center of attention, you can do so much more in the shadows.

entries.zh: 摧毁一个敌对的恒星基地将获得§H5§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Destroying an enemy starbase will yield §H5§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 征服一个敌对的殖民地将获得§H10§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Conquering an enemy colony will yield §H10§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 完全消灭一个帝国将获得§H100§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Destroying an entire empire will yield §H100§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 你所击败的敌军舰队的每点海军容量将使你获得§H1§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Defeating an enemy fleet will yield §H1§! £menace£ Menace per Naval Capacity.

entries.zh: 毁灭一个太空城邦将获得§H100§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Destroying an enclave will yield §H100§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 完全奴役一个物种将每年获得§H5§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Enslaving an entire species will yield §H5§! £menace£ Menace annually.

entries.zh: 拥有附庸将每年获得§H10§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Having vassals will yield §H10§! £menace£ Menace annually.

entries.zh: 附庸一个帝国将获得§H100§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Vassalizing an empire will yield §H100§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 被入侵土著星球上的每个£pop£人口将使你获得§H1§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Invading primitive worlds will yield §H1§! £menace£ Menace per £pop£ Pop.

entries.zh: 每个在掠袭轨道轰炸中劫得的£pop£ 人口将使你获得§H50§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Sending a Marauder Raid will yield §H50§! £menace£ Menace per £pop£ Pop.

entries.zh: 否决一个由大多数国家所支持的决议将获得§H5§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Forcing a proposal through - despite a majority of voters opposing it - will yield §H5§! £menace£ Menace.
Sit on the Galactic Community Council

entries.zh: 拥有星系理事会席位将每年获得§H10§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Having a position on the Galactic Community Council will yield §H10§! £menace£ Menace annually.

entries.zh: 动用理事会否决权否决议案将获得§H100§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Vetoing a resolution will yield §H100§! £menace£ Menace per resolution.

entries.zh: 请求得到的每点£favor£外交支持将使你获得§H1§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Calling in a favor will yield §H1§! £menace£ Menace per £favor£ Favor.

entries.zh: 赢得一场羞辱之战将获得§H200§!£menace£威慑力。
entries.en: Winning a Humiliation War will yield §H200§! £menace£ Menace.

entries.zh: 亲自上阵打击敌人？！噢，拜托，有人会帮我们料理这样的事务的。
entries.en: Attack them ourselves?! Oh, please - We have people who do that for us.

entries.zh: 解锁这一$crisis_perk$需要先同时雇佣4支掠夺者舰队。
entries.en: Hire a total of 4 Marauder Fleets in order to unlock this $crisis_perk$.

entries.zh: 掠夺者舰队租约时间延长30%。
掠夺者舰队租用价格下降50%。
他们与我们平起平坐。而且他们自己也会同意这个说法，不然的话……
entries.en: They are our equals. And they will concur with that statement, or else...

entries.zh: 成为一个至少有四位成员的霸权联邦的领袖。
entries.en: Be the leader of a Hegemony Federation with at least 3 other members.

entries.zh: 每位联邦成员提供§G+5联邦海军容量§!。
entries.en: §G+5 Federation Naval Capacity§! per Federation member.

entries.zh: 你们，当然啦，可以不执行我们的命令。不过嘛，你们要是敢的话，我们就只能消灭你们了。
entries.en: You are, of course, free to object to our demands. However, if you do, we will annihilate you.

entries.zh: 解锁这一$crisis_perk$需要先拥有至少4个附庸。
entries.en: Have at least 4 Vassals under your empire to unlock this $crisis_perk$.

entries.zh: 每个附庸每月上供的£energy£能量与£mineral£矿物增加10%。
entries.en: Each vassal contributes +10% more £energy£ Energy and £mineral£ Minerals every month.

entries.zh: 帝国每有一个附庸就增加20海军容量。
entries.en: Gain +20 Naval Capacity for every vassal under your empire.

entries.zh: 这好办！先把联邦68-XM式表单填满，然后在21号前交到11-B部门，接着再向这个部门要3份文件的副本，分别是……
entries.en: Simple! Fill in Federal Form 68-XM, hand it over to Section 11-B no later than the 21st, request three copies of...

entries.zh: 解锁这一$crisis_perk$需要先在星海共同体中提出3项制裁措施。
entries.en: Propose 3 sanctions in the Galactic Community to unlock this $crisis_perk$.

entries.zh: 提案花费的£influence£影响力减少20%。
获得对于§P违反§!星系法的豁免权。
entries.en: Gain immunity to being §P'in breach'§! of Galactic Community law.

entries.zh: 你很清楚这事应该怎么运作：你给我个面子，我就不灭了你。
entries.en: You know how this goes: you scratch my back, and I refrain from obliterating yours.

entries.zh: 解锁这一$crisis_perk$需要先求得20£favor£外交支持。
entries.en: Call in 20 £favor£ Favors to unlock this $crisis_perk$.

entries.zh: 请求£favor£外交支持不再需要花费£influence£影响力。
entries.en: Calling in £favor£ Favors cost no £influence£ Influence.

entries.zh: 你所了解的我们，是我们想让你了解的我们。至于我们对你们的了解有多少呢？答案是，一切。
entries.en: What you know about us, you know because we let you. What we know about you is 'everything'.

entries.zh: 解锁这一$crisis_perk$需要先完成§H10项间谍行动§!。
entries.en: Complete §H10 Operations§! in order to unlock this $crisis_perk$.

entries.zh: 谍报行动速度加快+20%，同时花费减少-20%。
entries.en: Espionage actions are +20% faster, and have a -20% cost.

entries.zh: 完成§H天灾目标§!以获取§Y威慑力§!。
威慑力是一种用于衡量我们与虚境中的灾祸能量共鸣程度的数值。
entries.en: Menace is a measure of our resonance with the calamitous energies of the Shroud.

entries.zh: 我们从这项天灾目标中获得了$AMOUNT$£menace£。
entries.en: We have gained £menace£ $AMOUNT$ from this Crisis Objective.

entries.zh: 在$LEVEL$，你会获得一个特殊项目和以下奖励：\n
entries.en: At $LEVEL$, you get a Special Project and the rewards:\n

entries.zh: 若想推进天灾等级，你需要满足天灾目标并完成情报日志里面的天灾特殊项目
entries.en: To advance through the Crisis levels, complete Crisis Objectives and research the Crisis Special Projects in the Situation Log

entries.zh:
星海共同体中那些希图在历史的长河中照见未来的人们长期以来一直设想会有一场将要降临的§R天灾§!——一场所有智慧生命的生死危机，唯有倚仗前所未有的万众一心与前仆后继方能克服——如果真有可能克服的话。

流行的关于何为这场天灾的本质的预测相当异想天开，比如系外掠食者入侵，再比如星系中机械智能星火燎原，又或是其他位面的继位战争波及而至，但是……

如今显而易见的是，那个天灾一直都会是§R我们§!。
entries.en:
Those in the galactic community who chart the arc of history have long predicted a coming §RCrisis§! - an existential threat to all sapient life which would require unprecedented unity of purpose, and sacrifice, to overcome. If it can be overcome at all.

Popular predictions as to the nature of this crisis have been as fanciful as the invasion of an extragalactic glutton, or the galaxy's machine intelligences rising up in petty rebellion, or a war of succession spilling over from another plane of existence, but...

It is now clear that it was always going to be §Rus§!.

entries.zh: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\n我们的一举一动激起的涟漪，回响在一个能量无限的维度中。我们只需发现如何驾驭这种能量就能让整个星系向我们卑躬屈膝。
entries.en: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\nOur actions have echoes in another dimension, one of limitless energy. We need only discover how to harness this power in order to bring the galaxy to heel.

entries.zh: 作为天灾完成§H天灾目标§!来产生£menace£§H威慑力§!，这样便能解锁帝国的毁灭性潜力，助您完成建造以太相引擎巨型结构的任务，为星系带来一个新的时代。
entries.en: Pursuing §HCrisis Objectives§! generates £menace£ §HMenace§!, unlocking our destructive potential in order to complete the Aetherophasic Engine Megastructure and bring about a new age for the galaxy.
Click here to go to the Ambition Tab

entries.zh: 命运之重张牙舞爪，我们在悬崖边缘战战兢兢，其下是血一般的未来。\n\n当我们凝视着深渊时，深渊中只有我们在回望着自己。
entries.en: We balance over the chasm of a bloody future as the gravity of destiny claws at us.\n\nAs we gaze into the abyss, we see only ourselves staring back.

entries.zh: 前进，摧毁，让一切归于死亡。
entries.en: Set forth to annihilate and cause havoc of excessive proportions.
